title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 19: the lamentation for the princes of Israel, the lioness and her cubs, and the vine planted in a dry land.

questions.text: What was the prophet to take up for the princes of Israel?
questions.explanation: He was told to take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel.

questions.text: What was their mother, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: The lamentation asks, 'What was your mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs.'

questions.text: What did the cub she brought up learn to do?
questions.explanation: He became a young lion, learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.

questions.text: Where was the first young lion brought with hooks?
questions.explanation: The nations heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.

questions.text: What did she do when she saw that her hope was lost?
questions.explanation: She took another of her cubs and made him a young lion.

answers.text: She took another of her cubs and made him a young lion
She lay down among the lions and died there
She went away alone into the wilderness
She gave the rest of her cubs to the nations

questions.text: Why was the land desolate, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: He knew their palaces and laid waste their cities, and the land was desolate with its fullness because of the noise of his roaring.

answers.text: Because of the noise of his roaring
Because of fire in its branches

questions.text: To whom did they bring the second lion in a cage?
questions.explanation: They put him in a cage with hooks and brought him to the king of Babylon.

answers.text: To the elders of the provinces

questions.text: Why was he brought into strongholds?
questions.explanation: They brought him into strongholds so that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.

answers.text: So that he might be healed of his wounds there
So that he might reign over the nations around
So that he might teach the young lions to hunt
So that his voice would no more be heard on the mountains of Israel

questions.text: What did the vine have strong branches for?
questions.explanation: The vine had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled, and their stature was exalted among the thick boughs.

answers.text: The scepters of those who ruled

questions.text: Where is the vine planted now, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.

answers.text: In the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land
Beside many waters in a good soil
In the garden of the king of Babylon
On the high mountain of Israel
